    <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_4" playOrder="4">
      <navLabel>
        <text>自序 开启自我改变的原动力</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="text/part0004.html"/>
    </navPoint>
    <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_5" playOrder="5">
      <navLabel>
        <text>上篇 内观自己，摆脱焦虑</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="text/part0005.html"/>
      <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_6" playOrder="6">
        <navLabel>
          <text>第一章 大脑——一切问题的起源</text>
        </navLabel>
        <content src="text/part0005.html#sigil_toc_id_3"/>
        <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_7" playOrder="7">
          <navLabel>
            <text>第一节 大脑：重新认识你自己</text>
          </navLabel>
          <content src="text/part0005.html#sigil_toc_id_4"/>
        </navPoint>
        <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_8" playOrder="8">
          <navLabel>
            <text>第二节 焦虑：焦虑的根源</text>
          </navLabel>
          <content src="text/part0005.html#sigil_toc_id_5"/>
        </navPoint>
        <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_9" playOrder="9">
          <navLabel>
            <text>第三节 耐心：得耐心者得天下</text>
          </navLabel>
          <content src="text/part0005.html#sigil_toc_id_6"/>
        </navPoint>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_10" playOrder="10">
        <navLabel>
          <text>第二章 潜意识——生命留给我们的彩蛋</text>
        </navLabel>
        <content src="text/part0006.html"/>
        <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_11" playOrder="11">
          <navLabel>
            <text>第一节 模糊：人生是一场消除模糊的比赛</text>
          </navLabel>
          <content src="text/part0006.html#sigil_toc_id_8"/>
        </navPoint>
        <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_12" playOrder="12">
          <navLabel>
            <text>第二节 感性：顶级的成长竟然是“凭感觉”</text>
          </navLabel>
          <content src="text/part0006.html#sigil_toc_id_9"/>
        </navPoint>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_13" playOrder="13">
        <navLabel>
          <text>第三章 元认知——人类的终极能能力</text>
        </navLabel>
        <content src="text/part0007.html"/>
        <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_14" playOrder="14">
          <navLabel>
            <text>第一节 元认知：成长慢，是因为你不会“飞”</text>
          </navLabel>
          <content src="text/part0007.html#sigil_toc_id_11"/>
        </navPoint>
        <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_15" playOrder="15">
          <navLabel>
            <text>第二节 自控力：我们生而为人就是为了成为思维舵手</text>
          </navLabel>
          <content src="text/part0007.html#sigil_toc_id_12"/>
        </navPoint>
      </navPoint>
    </navPoint>
    <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_16" playOrder="16">
      <navLabel>
        <text>下篇 外观世界，借力前行</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="text/part0008.html"/>
      <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_17" playOrder="17">
        <navLabel>
          <text>第四章 专注力——情绪和智慧的交叉地带</text>
        </navLabel>
        <content src="text/part0008.html#sigil_toc_id_14"/>
        <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_18" playOrder="18">
          <navLabel>
            <text>第一节 情绪专注：一招提振你的注意力</text>
          </navLabel>
          <content src="text/part0008.html#sigil_toc_id_15"/>
        </navPoint>
        <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_19" playOrder="19">
          <navLabel>
            <text>第二节 学习专注：深度沉浸是进化双刃剑的安全剑柄</text>
          </navLabel>
          <content src="text/part0008.html#sigil_toc_id_16"/>
        </navPoint>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_20" playOrder="20">
        <navLabel>
          <text>第五章 学习力——学习不是一味地努力</text>
        </navLabel>
        <content src="text/part0009.html"/>
        <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_21" playOrder="21">
          <navLabel>
            <text>第一节 匹配：舒适区边缘，适用于万物的方法论</text>
          </navLabel>
          <content src="text/part0009.html#sigil_toc_id_18"/>
        </navPoint>
        <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_22" playOrder="22">
          <navLabel>
            <text>第二节 深度：深度学习，人生为数不多的好出路</text>
          </navLabel>
          <content src="text/part0009.html#sigil_toc_id_19"/>
        </navPoint>
        <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_23" playOrder="23">
          <navLabel>
            <text>第三节 关联：高手的“暗箱”</text>
          </navLabel>
          <content src="text/part0009.html#sigil_toc_id_20"/>
        </navPoint>
        <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_24" playOrder="24">
          <navLabel>
            <text>第四节 体系：建立个人认知体系其实很简单</text>
          </navLabel>
          <content src="text/part0009.html#sigil_toc_id_21"/>
        </navPoint>
        <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_25" playOrder="25">
          <navLabel>
            <text>第五节 打卡：莫迷恋打卡，打卡打不出未来</text>
          </navLabel>
          <content src="text/part0009.html#sigil_toc_id_22"/>
        </navPoint>
        <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_26" playOrder="26">
          <navLabel>
            <text>第六节 反馈：是时候告诉你什么是真正的学习了</text>
          </navLabel>
          <content src="text/part0009.html#sigil_toc_id_23"/>
        </navPoint>
        <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_27" playOrder="27">
          <navLabel>
            <text>第七节 休息：你没成功，可能是因为太刻苦了</text>
          </navLabel>
          <content src="text/part0009.html#sigil_toc_id_24"/>
        </navPoint>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_28" playOrder="28">
        <navLabel>
          <text>第六章 行动力——没有行动世界只是个概念</text>
        </navLabel>
        <content src="text/part0010.html"/>
        <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_29" playOrder="29">
          <navLabel>
            <text>第一节 清晰：一个观念，重构你的行动力</text>
          </navLabel>
          <content src="text/part0010.html#sigil_toc_id_26"/>
        </navPoint>
        <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_30" playOrder="30">
          <navLabel>
            <text>第二节 “傻瓜”：这个世界会奖励那些不计得失的“傻瓜”</text>
          </navLabel>
          <content src="text/part0010.html#sigil_toc_id_27"/>
        </navPoint>
        <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_31" playOrder="31">
          <navLabel>
            <text>第三节 行动：“道理都懂，就是不做”怎么破解</text>
          </navLabel>
          <content src="text/part0010.html#sigil_toc_id_28"/>
        </navPoint>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_32" playOrder="32">
        <navLabel>
          <text>第七章 情绪力——情绪是多角度看问题的智慧</text>
        </navLabel>
        <content src="text/part0011.html"/>
        <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_33" playOrder="33">
          <navLabel>
            <text>第一节 心智带宽：唯有富足，方能解忧</text>
          </navLabel>
          <content src="text/part0011.html#sigil_toc_id_30"/>
        </navPoint>
        <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_34" playOrder="34">
          <navLabel>
            <text>第二节 单一视角：你的坏情绪，源于视角单一</text>
          </navLabel>
          <content src="text/part0011.html#sigil_toc_id_31"/>
        </navPoint>
        <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_35" playOrder="35">
          <navLabel>
            <text>第三节 游戏心态：幸福的人，总是在做另外一件事</text>
          </navLabel>
          <content src="text/part0011.html#sigil_toc_id_32"/>
        </navPoint>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_36" playOrder="36">
        <navLabel>
          <text>第八章 早冥读写跑，人生五件套——成本最低的成长之道</text>
        </navLabel>
        <content src="text/part0012.html"/>
        <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_37" playOrder="37">
          <navLabel>
            <text>第一节 早起：无闹钟、不参团、不打卡，我是如何坚持早起的</text>
          </navLabel>
          <content src="text/part0012.html#sigil_toc_id_34"/>
        </navPoint>
        <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_38" playOrder="38">
          <navLabel>
            <text>第二节 冥想：终有一天，你要解锁这条隐藏赛道</text>
          </navLabel>
          <content src="text/part0012.html#sigil_toc_id_35"/>
        </navPoint>
        <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_39" playOrder="39">
          <navLabel>
            <text>第三节 阅读：如何让自己真正爱上阅读</text>
          </navLabel>
          <content src="text/part0012.html#sigil_toc_id_36"/>
        </navPoint>
        <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_40" playOrder="40">
          <navLabel>
            <text>第四节 写作：谢谢你，费曼先生</text>
          </navLabel>
          <content src="text/part0012.html#sigil_toc_id_37"/>
        </navPoint>
        <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_41" playOrder="41">
          <navLabel>
            <text>第五节 运动：灵魂想要走得远，身体必须在路上</text>
          </navLabel>
          <content src="text/part0012.html#sigil_toc_id_38"/>
        </navPoint>
      </navPoint>
    </navPoint>
    <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_42" playOrder="42">
      <navLabel>
        <text>结语 一流的生活不是富有，而是觉知</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="text/part0013.html"/>
    </navPoint>
    <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_43" playOrder="43">
      <navLabel>
        <text>后记 共同改变，一起前行</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="text/part0014.html"/>
    </navPoint>
    <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_44" playOrder="44">
      <navLabel>
        <text>参考文献</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="text/part0015.html"/>
    </navPoint>
